meta.description: Create publication-quality scientific diagrams using Nano Banana 2 AI with smart iterative refinement. Uses Gemini 3.6 Flash for quality review. Only regenerates if quality is below threshold for your document type. Specialized in neural network architectures, system diagrams, flowcharts, biological pathways, and complex scientific visualizations.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive diagram generation with smart iteration, quality thresholds per document type, version tracking, review logging

reliability.note: Good reliability with iterative refinement, quality review, versioned outputs, review error handling; minor: no offline fallback

performance_context.note: Well-organized with quality threshold table, workflow explanation, output format disclosure (PNG raster only)

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with effective/ineffective prompt examples, document-type thresholds, smart iteration benefits, clear workflow steps

human_usability.note: Clear quick start with examples, API key setup, OpenRouter key link, prompt best practices

security.note: Good security with data transmission disclosure, unpublished data warning; minor: no rate limit or quota documentation

maintainability.note: Version 1.6, MIT license, openclaw metadata for API key management, clear model versions (Nano Banana 2, Gemini 3.6 Flash)

agent_specific.note: Strong composability (used by other skills), clear trigger; minor: escape hatch for API failures limited, version control integration not documented

Strong composability as this skill is explicitly integrated by research-grants and scientific-critical-thinking skills

recommendations.title: Document rate limits and API quota management
recommendations.problem: OpenRouter API usage documented but no rate limit or cost guidance
recommendations.root_cause: Security criterion: resource consumption not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add to ## Configuration: 'OpenRouter has per-key rate limits. Monitor usage at openrouter.ai/activity. Iterative refinement can consume 2-3 image generations per diagram.'

recommendations.title: Add explicit retry command for review failures
recommendations.problem: Retry mentioned as 'worth a try' but no command shown
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific escape hatch: recovery path not explicit
recommendations.fix: Add to review failure section: 'To retry: re-run the same generate_schematic.py command. Transient API errors often resolve on retry.'

recommendations.title: Document vector format conversion workflow
recommendations.problem: PNG-only output disclosed but conversion process not detailed
recommendations.root_cause: Functional suitability: journal requirements for vector formats
recommendations.fix: Add section: '## Vector Conversion: For journals requiring PDF/EPS: convert name.png -density 300 name.pdf (ImageMagick) or use Inkscape for PNG→SVG tracing. Check result at print size.'
